verdict.rationale: Logseq has an API surface (a local HTTP API server and plugin APIs), so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. The evidence explicitly states that no sandbox is published for that API. A user could create a separate local-only graph to test against, but that is a user-side workaround, not a documented sandbox capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
